error_maps: per-pixel RGB-MSE, shared color scale (vmax=0.7986) across stages
note: Exploratory probe for the SyncCaps TCSVT paper. Small decoders (interp+conv upsampler; vector stages prepend a linear adapter) trained 4 epochs, MSE, TRAIN split only; evaluated on TEST. Stem/primary are per-frame; the sync (class-evidence) stage decodes the per-clip final-tick sync vector to the temporally-central frame (frame 8) -- SyncCaps is routing-free so sync is the digit-capsule analog. Per-frame reconstruction from a per-clip aggregate is deliberately ill-posed; a class-prototype-like blur is expected and is the informative result (cf. Sabour et al. digit-capsule prototypes).
